Recommended actions

  • Run npm audit fix on affected sites to automatically fix vulnerabilities where possible
  • For breaking changes, run npm audit fix --force (review changes carefully)
  • Review the linked advisories for specific remediation steps
  • For critical vulnerabilities, prioritize immediate patching
